요한복음 8:1.content: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

요한복음 8:2.content: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

요한복음 8:3.content: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

요한복음 8:4.content: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

요한복음 8:5.content: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

요한복음 8:6.content: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

요한복음 8:7.content: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

요한복음 8:8.content: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

요한복음 8:9.content: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

요한복음 8:10.content: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

요한복음 8:11.content: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

요한복음 8:12.content: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

요한복음 8:13.content: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

요한복음 8:14.content: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

요한복음 8:15.content: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

요한복음 8:16.content: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

요한복음 8:17.content: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

요한복음 8:18.content: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

요한복음 8:19.content: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

요한복음 8:20.content: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

요한복음 8:21.content: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

요한복음 8:22.content: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

요한복음 8:23.content: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

요한복음 8:24.content: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

요한복음 8:25.content: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

요한복음 8:26.content: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

요한복음 8:27.content: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

요한복음 8:28.content: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

요한복음 8:29.content: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

요한복음 8:30.content: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

요한복음 8:31.content: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

요한복음 8:32.content: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

요한복음 8:33.content: They answered him, We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

요한복음 8:34.content: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

요한복음 8:35.content: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

요한복음 8:36.content: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

요한복음 8:37.content: I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

요한복음 8:38.content: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

요한복음 8:39.content: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

요한복음 8:40.content: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

요한복음 8:41.content: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

요한복음 8:42.content: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

요한복음 8:43.content: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

요한복음 8:44.content: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

요한복음 8:45.content: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

요한복음 8:46.content: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

요한복음 8:47.content: He that is of God heareth God’s words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

요한복음 8:48.content: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

요한복음 8:49.content: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

요한복음 8:50.content: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

요한복음 8:51.content: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

요한복음 8:52.content: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

요한복음 8:53.content: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

요한복음 8:54.content: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

요한복음 8:55.content: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

요한복음 8:56.content: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

요한복음 8:57.content: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

요한복음 8:58.content: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

요한복음 8:59.content: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
